    • readBytes

      public CompletionStage<UserFileReadResult<byte[]>> readBytes(UserFileHandle handle, int maxBytes)
      Description copied from interface: UserFileAccessService
      Reads at most maxBytes bytes, with a maximum request of 16 MiB. A larger file returns a bounded value with truncated=true; a request above this limit returns UserFileErrorCode.SIZE_LIMIT_EXCEEDED.
      Specified by:
      readBytes in interface UserFileAccessService

    • readBytesBounded

      public CompletionStage<UserFileReadResult<byte[]>> readBytesBounded(UserFileHandle handle, int maxBytes)
      Description copied from interface: UserFileAccessService
      Reads at most maxBytes bytes from the handle's file, with a maximum request limit of 128 MiB (134,217,728 bytes).

      A larger file returns a bounded value with truncated=true; a request above this 128 MiB limit returns UserFileErrorCode.SIZE_LIMIT_EXCEEDED.

      The default implementation provides backward compatibility: requests up to 16 MiB delegate to UserFileAccessService.readBytes(UserFileHandle, int), while requests above 16 MiB complete with a structured unsupported error (UserFileErrorCode.RUNTIME_UNAVAILABLE). Runtimes supporting higher limits override this method.

      Specified by:
      readBytesBounded in interface UserFileAccessService
      Parameters:
      handle - the granted user-file handle
      maxBytes - the maximum number of bytes to read, up to 134,217,728 (128 MiB)
      Returns:
      a completion stage with the read result or structured error
